scope: Public official scope and venue guidance. Clause-level and regulatory applicability determinations require additional authority and evidence.

sources.name: NeurIPS 2026 paper checklist review
sources.finding: Use the 16-question crosswalk. Track-specific submission requirements apply to a selected submission and deadline; paper and supporting statements need sign-off.

sources.name: NeurIPS main track 2026
sources.finding: Use as a dated reference. The repository does not establish institutional affiliation or a submission.

sources.name: NeurIPS ethics
sources.finding: Check asset rights, risks, people and reporting obligations for the selected paper.

sources.name: NeurIPS evaluations and datasets 2026
sources.finding: Re-evaluate executable artifact and dataset metadata requirements if this track and contribution type are chosen.

sources.name: ACM SIGSIM PADS artifact evaluation
sources.finding: Check functionality, reusability, persistent availability and external evaluation separately. Central policy endpoint returned HTTP 403; this is publisher-hosted venue guidance, not an awarded badge.

sources.name: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15289:2019
sources.finding: Map life-cycle information items. The public scope refers to dated 12207 and 15288 editions. Clause-level conformity is unassessed.

sources.name: ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207:2026
sources.finding: Use current software lifecycle scope for implementation, verification, transition and maintenance records. Clause-level conformity is unassessed.

sources.name: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023
sources.finding: Treat research and deployment lifecycles separately. Clause-level conformity is unassessed.

sources.name: ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022
sources.finding: Architecture descriptions need stakeholder concerns, viewpoints, correspondences and rationale. Clause-level conformity is unassessed.

sources.name: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018
sources.finding: Bind requirements and acceptance to traced implementation and evidence. Published edition rather than the successor draft.

sources.name: IEEE 1012-2024
sources.finding: Scope V&V activities and evidence by lifecycle and independence. Clause-level conformity is unassessed.

sources.name: ISO/IEC 25010:2023
sources.finding: Specify software quality attributes and observed evidence per measured boundary.

sources.name: ISO/IEC 25059:2023
sources.finding: AI quality reference for scoped evaluations. A successor draft is not a published requirement.

sources.name: ISO/IEC 5259 series
sources.finding: Track AI data quality measures, provenance, admission and lifecycle governance. Series clauses are unassessed.

sources.name: ISO/IEC 23894:2023
sources.finding: Scope AI risks and mitigations by research use and actual system capabilities.

sources.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
sources.finding: Organizational management system requirements would need an owner, scope and operating evidence.

sources.name: ISO 9001:2026
sources.finding: Quality management system requirements are a reference; organizational conformity is unassessed.

sources.name: ISO 31000:2018
sources.finding: Risk ownership, treatment and monitoring. Guidance framework.

sources.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
sources.finding: Inform information-security governance. A repository security scan does not establish ISMS conformity.

sources.name: IEC 60812:2018
sources.finding: FMEA applies to software and interfaces when selected for risk analysis.

sources.name: IEC 61025:2006
sources.finding: Fault-tree methodology may support analysis of research evidence or release-governance failures.

sources.name: IEC 61508-1:2010
sources.finding: No operational electrical/electronic/programmable electronic safety-function claim is in the research scope. Reassess before such use.

sources.name: ISO 12100:2010
sources.finding: No machinery design or operation is included in the current repository scope. Reassess if that scope changes.

sources.name: ISO/IEC 17025:2017
sources.finding: No accreditation of a testing or calibration laboratory is requested or established in the current software research scope.

sources.name: JCGM GUM-1:2023
sources.finding: Use measurement scope, uncertainty and boundary conditions where they apply to actual instruments.

sources.name: FAIR Guiding Principles
sources.finding: Provide persistent identities, provenance and documented access including authorization as needed. Source terms determine redistribution.

sources.name: W3C PROV
sources.finding: Distinguish artifact entities, executions and accountable agents in evidence lineage.

sources.name: NIST AI RMF 1.0
sources.finding: Use GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE as appropriate to actual use. Framework adoption is unassessed.

sources.name: EU AI Act
sources.finding: Article 2 contains scoped research conditions. Determine actual development, testing, supply, deployment and jurisdiction; no blanket exemption.

sources.name: EU GDPR
sources.finding: Determine territorial scope, actual personal-data processing, obligations and applicable exceptions. Public access alone does not settle these facts.

sources.name: Institution-specific requirements
sources.finding: The repository establishes no institution or contract imposing a different rubric. Obtain the actual institution and official rules if designated; the URL is the prospective venue checklist, not institutional proof.
